Resolve `theme_use` input to a ggplot2 theme object

Source: R/utils-resolve.R
dot-resolve_theme.Rd

The theme resolver shared by plotting functions in UtilsR and RegR. Accepts a theme object, a function returning a theme, or a function-name string. NULL uses theme_km, with ggplot2::theme_bw() as the fallback. Names are looked up as functions visible to the immediate caller, then as UtilsR exports, then as ggplot2 exports. Pass a function or theme object for a local custom theme used through a plotting wrapper. Errors evaluating a visible binding or calling a theme function are preserved. Theme functions are called without arguments by default. Supply settings in a closure or pass them through ....

Usage

.resolve_theme(theme_use, ...)

Arguments

theme_use

NULL, a single non-missing, non-empty theme name, a function returning a theme, or a theme object.

...

Arguments forwarded to the theme function when one is used. Ignored when the specification resolves to a theme object.

Value

A ggplot2 theme object.

See also

Other ggplot2 themes: leg1(), leg2(), theme_ROC(), theme_alluvia(), theme_blank(), theme_heat(), theme_km, theme_legend(), theme_legend1(), theme_my(), theme_rcs, theme_sc(), theme_scatter

Examples

.resolve_theme("theme_bw")
